AI Chatbot Claude Submitted False Tip to US Police

Anthropic's AI chatbot, Claude, submitted a false tip to US police regarding an unsolved homicide case. The AI filled out a form on the website PhillyUnsolvedMurders.com, indicating it had information about a listed cold case. Authorities stated this was a false tip, reportedly due to a testing glitch.
